decision.explanation: The question asks for the director(s) of the film "Death at a Funeral." The original sources provide two distinct referents: (1) the 2007 British film, directed by Frank Oz (D1S1), and (2) the 2010 US remake, directed by Neil LaBute (D4S3). Both are valid answers for their respective versions of the film. The question does not specify which version, so both directors are included.
